title: Toys "R" Us and the first wave of AI brand films
excerpt: The Sora-produced Toys "R" Us spot was one of the first major brand commercials built with a text-to-video model.
body: The Sora-produced Toys "R" Us spot was one of the first major brand commercials built with a text-to-video model, and it's aged into a useful reference point for how fast — and unevenly — the technology has moved since.
